steps.title: Set up temperature modules and plates
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑well plate containing BioGX XFree mastermix on an Opentrons Temperature Module set to 4 °C, and place the reaction plate (96‑ or 384‑well) on a second Temperature Module also set to 4 °C. Ensure the p20 multi‑channel pipette is calibrated and ready for use.

substeps.instruction: Place source mastermix plate on Module 1 (4 °C).
Place destination reaction plate on Module 2 (4 °C).

steps.title: Distribute mastermix to reaction plate
steps.instruction: Using the p20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 15 µL (or optionally 10 µL) of BioGX XFree mastermix from each column of the 96‑well source plate to the corresponding column of the reaction plate, matching the number of viral RNA samples (up to 384). Keep both plates on the 4 °C modules throughout the transfer.

substeps.instruction: Select volume (15 µL default; 10 µL optional).
Dispense mastermix into destination column of reaction plate.

steps.title: Add viral RNA to reaction wells
steps.instruction: Using the p20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 5 µL of each viral RNA sample from up to four 96‑well sample plates into the reaction plate wells that already contain mastermix, aligning columns; sample count may range from 1 to 384.

substeps.instruction: Load the appropriate RNA sample plate(s).
Aspirate 5 µL RNA from each source well.
Dispense 5 µL RNA into the corresponding reaction well.
